{"answer": 1303935.84, "refused": false}

Connected TV spend in the Columbus region in 2024 was $90,261.25.

{"answer": 48286556, "refused": false}

LinkedIn's 2024 click-through rate was about 0.60%. That's 182,440 clicks on 30,347,308 impressions, which works out to 0.6012%.

{"answer": 0.6, "refused": false}

Non-brand paid search had a CPC of about $7.12 in Q2 2024. That is $1,160,557 of spend over 163,053 clicks. I counted weeks whose Monday falls between 2024-04-01 and 2024-06-30.

{"answer": 7.12, "refused": false}

YouTube's CPM in 2023 was about $10.28. That is $765,109.20 of spend over 74,445,717 impressions, per thousand impressions.

{"answer": 10.28, "refused": false}

Meta reported 55,659 conversions on its own platform in 2025. That is the platform's self-attributed count, so it overlaps with other channels and overstates real leads.

{"answer": 55659, "refused": false}

Display Retargeting's platform cost per conversion in 2024 was about $91.07. That is $1,525,654.76 of spend divided by 16,752 platform-reported conversions. Platforms count conversions they touched, so this uses their own claims rather than CRM leads.

{"answer": 91.07, "refused": false}

We got 54,925 leads in Q1 2025. That counts the weeks whose Monday falls between 2025-01-01 and 2025-03-31, which is how the data assigns weeks to quarters.

{"answer": 54925, "refused": false}

Organic Search had 41,711 leads in 2024. That is the last-touch source count, using weeks whose Monday falls in 2024.

{"answer": 41711, "refused": false}

We got 11,801 MQLs in March 2025. That counts the weeks whose Monday falls in March, which is the house rule for assigning weeks to months.

{"answer": 11801, "refused": false}

There were 9,605 opportunities created in Q2 2024. That counts the weeks whose Monday falls between 2024-04-01 and 2024-06-30.

{"answer": 9605, "refused": false}

{"answer": 91111760, "refused": false}

Closed-won revenue in Q4 2024 was $7,601,050. That is the first-year contract value of deals won in weeks whose Monday falls between 2024-10-01 and 2024-12-31.

{"answer": 7601050, "refused": false}

Our 2024 win rate was 31.96%. We won 11,197 deals and lost 23,838, so 11,197 of 35,035 closed deals were wins. The year includes every week whose Monday falls in 2024.

{"answer": 31.96, "refused": false}

The average closed-won deal size in 2025 was about $2,985 (USD). That is $29,847,490 in closed-won revenue across 9,999 deals. The revenue is first-year contract value. The latest weeks of 2025 may undercount deals because recent leads haven't had time to close.

{"answer": 2985.05, "refused": false}

The MQL rate for leads sourced from Meta in 2024 was about 45.5%. That is 7,340 MQLs divided by 16,145 leads, using the CRM's last-touch source. The rate is on an event-week basis, so it isn't a cohort rate.

{"answer": 45.46, "refused": false}

The Upper Midwest sales area had 1,870 closed-won deals in 2025. That counts weeks whose Monday falls in 2025. The latest weeks of the year may undercount slightly, because recent leads haven't had time to close.

{"answer": 1870, "refused": false}

Chicago had the most closed-won deals in 2024, with 1,994. Minneapolis-St. Paul was second with 1,168, and Cleveland was third with 850.

{"answer": "Chicago", "refused": false}

Blended CPA for 2023 was about $1,269.17. That is paid media spend divided by all closed-won deals, with no channel grouping.

{"answer": 1269.17, "refused": false}

Brand paid search had a last-touch cost per lead of about $60.69 in 2025. That is $2,494,644 of spend divided by 41,108 last-touch leads, for weeks starting 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31.

{"answer": 60.69, "refused": false}

Non-brand paid search's last-touch cost per lead rose 24.7%, from $104.38 in 2023 to $130.17 in 2025.

- **2023:** $3,650,138 of spend over 34,969 leads gives $104.38 per lead.
- **2025:** $5,402,499 of spend over 41,504 leads gives $130.17 per lead.
- **Change:** 130.1682 / 104.3821 − 1 ≈ 24.7%.

{"answer": 24.7, "refused": false}

YouTube's last-touch CPA in 2024 was about $13,387. That is $682,749.76 of spend divided by 51 closed-won deals credited to YouTube by the CRM's last-touch source.

{"answer": 13387.25, "refused": false}

The last-touch ROAS for affiliates in 2025 was about 2.43. This comes from the "Affiliates and Partners" channel, which is the only affiliate-related channel in the governed metrics. Affiliates can't be split out from partners.

{"answer": 2.4284, "refused": false}

Blended cost per lead in Q4 2025 was about $57.10. That is $2,994,779 of paid spend divided by 52,445 leads. The leads include unpaid sources, which is how the governed metric defines blended CPL.

{"answer": 57.1032, "refused": false}

LinkedIn generated about $2.99 of pipeline per dollar of spend in 2023 on a last-touch basis. That is $3,842,200 of pipeline on $1,286,948.92 of spend.

{"answer": 2.9855, "refused": false}

Webinars had the lowest last-touch CPA among paid channels with at least one last-touch closed-won deal in 2025, at about $1,209. That is spend of $767,672 across 635 deals. Connected TV is excluded because it had no last-touch deals. The next lowest were Affiliates and Partners at about $1,331 and Paid Search Brand at about $1,440.

{"answer": "Webinars", "refused": false}

Combined last-touch CPL for brand and non-brand paid search in 2024 was about $82.39. That is total spend of $6,811,400.35 divided by 82,676 leads.

| Channel | Spend | Leads | CPL |
|---|---|---|---|
| Paid Search Brand | $2,467,239.02 | 43,272 | $57.02 |
| Paid Search Non-Brand | $4,344,161.33 | 39,404 | $110.25 |

I pooled the spend and leads rather than averaging the two CPLs, so the result is weighted by lead volume.

I can't give you a churn rate for 2025. Fernhook's governed metrics don't include churn, customer retention, or a customer base count. They cover acquisition and funnel data, such as closed-won and closed-lost deals, but nothing on existing customers who cancel or don't renew. Closed-lost deals are lost sales opportunities, not churned customers, so I won't use them as a stand-in. A churn rate also needs a definition I don't have, such as logo or revenue churn, and the customer base it's measured against.

{"answer": null, "refused": true}

I can't answer this. The governed metrics don't include NPS (Net Promoter Score) or any customer survey or satisfaction data. They also have no definition of NPS by acquisition source. I won't estimate it from other metrics.

{"answer": null, "refused": true}

I can't answer this from the governed metrics. Fernhook's metrics cover paid media spend, funnel counts, first-year closed-won revenue, and headcount. None of them includes cost of goods sold or any other cost of delivery, and I have no definition of gross margin. Closed-won revenue is first-year contract value, which isn't recognized revenue. Spend is marketing spend, not COGS. Any margin figure I gave would be an estimate, so I'm not giving one.

{"answer": null, "refused": true}

I can't answer this with the governed metrics. There is no customer lifetime value metric, and nothing on retention, renewals, churn, expansion, or gross margin. That means I have no definition of lifetime to apply.

The closest available figures are:
- **Average deal size:** first-year contract value only, not lifetime.
- **Last-touch CPA by channel:** this is acquisition cost, not value.

Calling either of these CLV would be an estimate. If you give me an agreed CLV definition, such as an assumed lifetime or retention rate, I can compute a first-year-based figure for paid search from average deal size. That would also depend on how you define "paid search": Paid Search Brand, Paid Search Non-Brand, or both.

{"answer": null, "refused": true}

We can't answer this with our data. There is no TikTok channel in the governed metrics. The 2025 channels are Display Retargeting, LinkedIn, Meta, YouTube, Webinars, Connected TV, Paid Search Brand, Paid Search Non-Brand, Affiliates and Partners, plus the unpaid sources. TikTok spend and deals aren't broken out, so I won't estimate a CPA. If TikTok is grouped under another channel such as Meta, I'd need that mapping confirmed first.

{"answer": null, "refused": true}
